replies.question: Can I use the template in Arabic?
replies.reply: Yes, all project boards, invoice formulas, and guide documents are fully translated into Arabic and English.

replies.question: I bought it twice by mistake, can I get my money back?
replies.reply: I am escalating this refund request directly to the founder for processing.

replies.question: Does it work on the Notion free plan?
replies.reply: Yes, the template pack works smoothly on the standard Notion free plan without any paid upgrades required.
